Insert text and multimonitor screenshots into .xlsx workbooks with workbookspecific backups. title: Excel Inserter for Windows AlgoLassi Algolassi image: https://algolassi.online/assets/images/algolassisocialcard.png [🏠 Home ▼ ](/) [📚 Tutorials ](/tutorials/) [ℹ️ About ](/aboutalgolassi/) / 📄 Excel Inserter for Windows AlgoLassi [← All Algolassi products](/products/) Download Excel Inserter v1.0.0 The selfcontained Windows x64 release is available now. The ZIP is the recommended download because it includes the executable and its SHA256 checksum file. A standalone EXE and the release details are also available. [↓ Download Windows x64 (ZIP · 47.5 MB)](https://github.com/greatPHPer/excel%5Finserter%5Freleases/releases/download/v1.0.0/ExcelInserterwinx64.zip) [↓ Download standalone EXE (122.9 MB)](https://github.com/greatPHPer/excel%5Finserter%5Freleases/releases/download/v1.0.0/ExcelInserter.exe) [SHA256 checksums](https://github.com/greatPHPer/excel%5Finserter%5Freleases/releases/download/v1.0.0/SHA256SUMS.txt) [Release notes and details](https://github.com/greatPHPer/excel%5Finserter%5Freleases/releases/tag/v1.0.0) [GitHub releases repository ↗](https://github.com/greatPHPer/excel%5Finserter%5Freleases) Verify the download: compare the SHA256 hash of the downloaded EXE with the value in SHA256SUMS.txt before running it. Do not run the file if the hashes differ. What Excel Inserter does Excel Inserter is designed for quickly collecting notes and screen evidence in a workbook without manually resizing rows, splitting long text, or pasting screenshots one by one. Insert text down column A Long notes are split into screenwidthsized chunks. Each chunk occupies one row in column A, Wrap Text stays disabled, and columns B onward are left untouched. Capture all monitors Capture the full virtual desktop across connected monitors and insert it as an image in the selected worksheet. The image can be fitted to the estimated Excel viewport or kept at its original pixel size. Find the recent workbook When the popup opens, the utility checks the current Windows user's Excel recentfile list for a local .xlsx workbook. The last manually selected workbook is used as a fallback. Keep workbookspecific backups Before an insertion, the app creates a timestamped backup in a dedicated folder associated with that workbook. The popup can delete the newest backup or all registered backups for the selected workbook, with confirmation. How to use it 1. Download the ZIP, extract it, and run ExcelInserter.exe. 2. Open the tray popup and choose the .xlsx workbook and worksheet. The most recently used local Excel workbook is selected automatically when available. 3. Type a note and choose Insert Text, or choose Capture Screen & Insert Image to add a screenshot of all monitors. 4. Use the blankrow setting to control spacing between the previous worksheet content and the next insertion. 5. Use the backup controls to remove the newest or all registered backups for the selected workbook when they are no longer needed. Requirements and limitations Supports Windows 10 or Windows 11 on x64 PCs. Supports .xlsx workbooks only. Legacy .xls and macroenabled .xlsm files are not supported. The workbook must be closed in Excel while an insertion is performed. If the recent workbook is open or locked, the app asks you to save and close it; it does not close Excel or discard unsaved changes automatically. Excel does not need to be installed to edit the workbook. Workbook operations are handled by the ClosedXML library. Text chunk widths and screenshot fitting are estimates based on the selected monitor and worksheet settings; the result can vary with Excel window size, zoom, ribbon layout, and display scaling. The v1.0.0 executable is not Authenticodesigned. Windows may display a Microsoft Defender SmartScreen warning because the app is not yet a commonly downloaded signed application. Download only from the official release page and verify the checksum. items.author: CH-Abhinav
items.descZh: JNum 是一个为现代 Java 和 Kotlin 设计的高性能纯原生数值计算与张量库，旨在解决传统 JVM 数值库（如 ND4J）依赖原生 C++ 后端和 JNI 边界所带来的部署复杂性、内存安全风险及性能开销。其核心功能基于 Project Panama 的 Foreign Function & Memory API 与 Vector API，实现了无需原生编译链的硬件 SIMD 加速、自适应 GEMM 矩阵乘法引擎、零拷贝切片与符号表达式评估，同时提供内置的纯 Java 神经网络推理模块。基准测试显示，JNum 在矩阵乘法和超越函数计算上性能突出，例如在 1024×1024 矩阵乘法中较 NumPy 提升约 1.5 倍、较 ND4J 提升超 100 倍，在 1 亿元素级三角函数与激活函数计算中与 NumPy 持平或更快，显著优于其他 JVM 数值引擎。该库适用于需要高性能数值计算、机器学习推理、科学计算的 Java/Kotlin 场景，尤其适合追求简化部署、内存安全与跨平台一致性的应用。
items.quote: JNum 为 JVM 带来了符合人体工程学的 NumPy 和 PyTorch 以及本机 BLAS 性能 — 无需本机 ++ 构建工具链、JNI 边界、垃圾收集

items.title: Show HN: Gohawk – A Resource Leak and Concurrency Static Analyzer for Go
items.desc: description: Find concurrency and resource management bugs at compiletime using gohawk’s advanced suite of static analyzers. title: gohawk Resourcefocused static analysis for Go [Skip to content](%5Ftop) gohawk Watch for bugs like a hawk gohawk is an industrialgrade static analyzer that finds resource management and concurrency issues in Go code. It has been used to find and fix bugs in [Docker](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53517), [Kubernetes](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/142429), and [Caddy](https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy/pull/7968). [Get started →](installation/) ‹ cache.go 1func refresh() { 2 index.Lock() 3 defer index.Unlock() 4 cache.Lock() 5 defer cache.Unlock() 6} 7 8func reset() { 9 cache.Lock() 10 defer cache.Unlock() 11 index.Lock() 12 defer index.Unlock() 13} lockordercontradictory lock order: index and cache config.go 1func load(path string) (Config, error) { 2 file, err := os.Open(path) 3 if err = nil { 4 return Config{}, err 5 } 6 7 var config Config 8 if err := json.NewDecoder(file).Decode(&config); err = nil { 9 return Config{}, err 10 } 11 return config, nil 12} 13 resourcelifetimeowned resource from os.Open is not released on every return path refresh.go 1func refresh() error { 2 done := make(chan struct{}) 3 go func() { 4 defer close(done) 5 updateCache() 6 }() 7 8 if err := syncIndex(); err = nil { 9 return err 10 } 11 <done 12 return nil 13} goroutineownershipgoroutine is not joined on every return path worker.go 1func collect(items \[\]Item) error { 2 var err error 3 for \_, item := range items { 4 go func() { 5 prepare(item) 6 err = fetch(item) 7 }() 8 } 9 10 return err 11} 12 13 concurrentcapturecaptured local err is mutated by goroutines launched repeatedly › Better together gohawk complements your existing analyzers such as go vet, Staticcheck, and gocritic; it does not try to replace them. Easy to drop in gohawk runs as a standalone tool or as a go vet tool. No configuration file, and every check is a commandline flag. Analysis features gohawk analyzers are primarily focused on enforcing reliability around resource management, concurrency, and error handling. [runtests.sh](/cookiengineer/qwenreasoningtrainer/blob/master/runtests.sh "runtests.sh") View all files Repository files navigation Qwen3.8 27B Reasoning Trainer This is a Pure Go Abliteration, Reasoning Training, and Inference stack. It is implemented with a CPU backend and a Vulkan backend, which uses compute shaders and GPU kernels. It implements a complete GGUF/quant stack for the Qwen 3.8 27B model in its Q4_K_M GGUF quantization. Motivation This project aims to make Qwen3.8 selftraining feasible for consumergrade hardware, open source, for everyone to reproduce by themselves. It is recommended to use the Qwen Reasoning Trainer stack with 48GB VRAM GPUs. Abliteration, Reasoning Training, and Inference is tested actively on a machine with an AMD Radeon Pro W7800 48GB GPU and with 96GB DDR5 SODIMM CPU memory available. The costs for the hardware of self training a Qwen3.8 model is at a budget of around 5000 EUR, even in this ongoing RAM crisis. Hardware requirements depend on the amount of contextlength, the memory calculation is like this: Around 17GB for the model weights A couple of MB for GPU kernels (negligible) Additional memory for K/V and cache (~10GB for 512k, ~20GB for 1M) That is why it's recommended to use a 32GB VRAM GPU for 512k context length, and a 48GB VRAM GPU for 1M context length. And yes, selfhosted, local, on consumergrade hardware. Pretty awesome, huh? The Qwen Trainer project started as an experiment of making Qwen3.8 think like DeepSeek. The training pipeline meanwhile is reproducible and confirmed by others. The reason for doing so is that DeepSeek v4.1 Flash is very good at planning of coding tasks, but isn't good at cyber security or exploit validation tasks anymore because the model has been censored heavily compared to the previous DeepSeek v4 Promodel. As v4 Pro is now as overpriced as 'murican models, I decided to go this route. The CPU backend kernel stack and the K/V cache implementations have been partially reused from my own experimental [gonano SIMD model](https://github.com/cookiengineer/gonano)that focuses on better SIMD inference and scales with CPUs (but has its own limitations due to Go not having lower precisions than float32 available as of today, sadly). Requirements Go 1.27 (build and tests). glslc and spirvval to rebuild the committed SPIRV shaders. A Vulkan device for GPU acceleration and the GPU tests (the CLI selects it automatically when it has enough memory). python3 with venv support only for the external verify tests. Prerequisites 1. Download the Qwen3.827B model from Hugging Face. Unsloth Dynamic Q4\_K\_M quantization is the best model for this due to its weightsinmemory usage of around 17GB of VRAM. Repository: <https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.827BGGUF File: in the Files and versions list on the right side of the repo page, download Qwen3.827BUDQ4_K_M.gguf and place it at models/Qwen3.827BUDQ4_K_M.gguf. Alternatively let the CLI fetch the pinned artifact for you: Download the Qwen3.8 27B Q4_K_M model from huggingface: ./build/qwentrainer download; 1. Export the training data from your Opencode environment. Use the session history as the teacher model's reasoning traces. The [opencodereasoningextractor](https://github.com/cookiengineer/opencodereasoningextractor)tool writes the following files for an exported dataset: manifest.json sft/<topic/sessions.jsonl sft/<topic/turns.jsonl subagents/<topic/... rl/metadata.jsonl. Export Reasoning Traces from your previous Opencode Sessions opencodereasoningextractor ~/.local/share/opencod

items.descZh: 该项目旨在通过从其他教师模型（如DeepSeek）提取推理轨迹，降低 Qwen3.8 27B 模型的自训练门槛，解决特定领域（如网络安全、漏洞验证）中大模型审查过严的问题。核心功能基于纯 Go 语言构建，完整实现了 Abliteration、推理训练及推理栈，支持 CPU 后端与基于 Vulkan 计算着色器的 GPU 加速，并完整兼容 Q4_K_M GGUF 量化格式。其最大亮点在于对消费级硬件的极佳支持，模型权重仅占约 17GB VRAM，配合 KV 缓存（512k 上下文约 10GB，1M 约 20GB），推荐使用 32GB 至 48GB VRAM 显卡，整体自训练硬件预算可控制在约 5000 欧元。该工具链适用于希望在本地无审查环境下，利用低成本消费级硬件进行模型微调、代码规划及安全研究的开发者和安全从业者。
items.quote: 即使在当前内存危机的情况下，自行训练一个 Qwen3.8 模型的硬件成本也在 5000 欧元左右的预算范围内。
